reviewNotes: Résumé prioritizes AWS migration, application performance, implementation support, and project coordination for a 1–2 page target; final pagination depends on rendering. CV retains all work history, education, skills, and achievements. The master supports a bachelor's degree and relevant cloud experience but does not establish 2+ years specifically in infrastructure or AWS development. Terraform/IaC, shared-module governance, Azure, FinOps, CNAPP, Front Door/ALB/WAF, enterprise-scale production support, formal incident response/root-cause analysis, and rotating on-call experience are not documented. Work authorization and sponsorship eligibility require confirmation. Syntax and field types were reviewed without tools; no automated validation was performed.
